The evidence entry for it also cited a 404 Nevo URL with a PARAPHRASED snippet presented as a quote; both replaced with the wikisource consolidated text and the real verbatim wording.

PROCESS, the most important lesson of this cycle: fixing that last carry item INTRODUCED two fabricated legal powers. The first draft of Step 7 asserted the registrar can restrict a DRIVING LICENCE and can stop the debtor OPENING BANK ACCOUNTS. Neither exists: sec. 66a is a closed list of five (passport/travel document, exit ban, לקוח מוגבל מיוחד, כרטיס חיוב, founding or being a בעל עניין in a corporation), and the word נהיגה appears zero times in the entire statute. The Hebrew also mislabelled the cheque restriction as חייב מוגבל באמצעים, a different status that constrains the CREDITOR. All three came from a research summary that was transcribed rather than checked against the provision. Opening the statute took two minutes and would have prevented all three.

ALSO FIXED beyond the carry list: a scope gate in Step 1 (the suppliers law governs a purchaser buying in the course of business and supplies NO statutory due date for a private consumer client, and every downstream date inherits that answer); a new Step 6.5 on חדלות פירעון (a stay halts collection, and a תביעת חוב must be filed with the נאמן within a limited window or the debt is not counted, the one place in this workflow where inaction forfeits the debt); venue restated as a plaintiff's CHOICE rather than fixed by the debtor's address; interim attachment (עיקול זמני) for a debtor who is dissipating assets; the two dmei pigurim start dates reconciled; '75 days' corrected to a start-of-month maximum against about 46 at month-end; VAT Law sec. 7 (late-payment interest sits inside the VAT base); and a 404 Kol Zchut suppliers URL.

Deliberately NOT stated: the number of months to file a תביעת חוב. It could not be verified this cycle, so the skill tells the user to read the deadline off the published notice or the trustee's instructions and diarise it. Do not fill this in from memory next cycle; source it.

Expert MAJOR deferred (SKILL.md is at the 5,000-word cap, so any of these requires moving content to references/ first): personal guarantee / ערבות אישית from a controlling shareholder, which is what makes an instrument from an asset-less בע"מ worth anything and is obtainable at exactly the Step 5.5 moment; handling of a DISPUTED debt as distinct from simple non-payment, including that the שטרות shortcut collapses on an objection; the missing first move of phoning to find out whether the invoice ever entered the client's payment run, which resolves a large share of these files at no cost to goodwill; an individual (rather than corporate) debtor, where רשם החברות does not apply and protected-minimum garnishment rules do; and a Shabbat/holiday scheduling spec precise enough to implement (which location's sunset, candle-lighting and מוצאי שבת offsets, ערב חג, חול המועד, and a fallback when the hebcal MCP is unavailable).

PANEL ROUND 2 found three MORE unsourced misstatements of the suppliers law and the Execution Law, all now fixed and evidenced: (a) the state-body term was written as cumulative ('within 45 days AND not later than shotef+30') when sec. 3(a) sets two ALTERNATIVE limbs and the contract decides which applies; (b) the local-authority clock was keyed to the month the invoice was ISSUED when sec. 3(f)(1) says הומצא, the month it was SUBMITTED, which is the same issue-vs-due confusion this cycle was fixing everywhere else; (c) the 30-day wait before filing a judgment for enforcement was stated three times as absolute when sec. 6(b) makes it residual (the date IN the judgment governs; where the judgment issued in the debtor's absence and the creditor served it, the 30 days run from service) and sec. 6(b1) lets the registrar allow earlier filing on affidavit.

Expert claim REJECTED after verification, do not re-litigate: the Expert asserted that a driving-licence restriction exists in the sec. 66a family for maintenance (מזונות) debts and that the skill's flat 'no such power' misstates the statute. The consolidated text does not support it: נהיגה appears ZERO times in the whole Execution Law, and sec. 66a(6) is marked (נמחקה). A sixth limb did once exist and was deleted, which is almost certainly what the Expert was remembering, so the skill now says exactly that in a parenthesis. The flat statement stands.

Expert ranked the remaining gaps and explicitly assessed all as log-not-block. #1 by outcome, and the one to take first next cycle: the PERSONAL GUARANTEE (ערבות אישית) from a controlling shareholder. It ranks first because its window closes permanently: the moment the debtor asks for time is the only moment a בעל שליטה will sign, Step 5.5 already has the user in exactly that conversation asking for post-dated cheques or a שטר חוב, and it is one clause in an already-correct paragraph. It is the difference between a judgment against an emptied company, which the skill itself says is worth nothing, and a collectable individual. #2 disputed debt (partly covered: Step 6 already routes a genuine dispute to a lawyer, but the mechanic that the שטרות shortcut COLLAPSES into a full court case on the debtor's objection is mentioned only in passing in Step 7 and is not connected to the dispute analysis). #3 individual debtor. #4 the phone call to check the invoice ever entered the payment run, which the Expert rates highest hit-rate-per-minute of anything in the document.

Expert MINOR deferred: on the consumer branch of the new Step 1 scope gate, the skill says 'no statutory date' and then gives the user nothing to do. Two sentences would fix it: where the contract is silent a written demand is itself what fixes the date of default, so the demand letter matters MORE against a consumer, not less; and the suppliers law is mandatory and cannot be contracted out of on the business branch, which is the answer when a client says 'our standard terms are shotef+120'.

Deliberately still NOT stated, second cycle running: the תביעת חוב filing period. The Expert independently expects six months from the צו פתיחת הליכים under the Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law 5778-2018 with trustee extension, but could not pin a section and would not publish the number either. It confirmed the omission is the correct posture, since the skill preserves the right by telling the user to read the deadline off the notice and diarise it. Source it properly before ever writing a figure.

PANEL ROUND 3 caught a class of error neither earlier round did: a citation that is CORRECTLY QUOTED but points at REPEALED text. The small-claims venue paragraph offered 'where the undertaking was made or where it was to be performed' as connecting factors. Reg. 2(a) marks paragraphs (2), (3) and (4) as (נמחקה); only the defendant's residence or place of business and the place of the act or omission survive. The Hebrew compounded it with 'בין יתר זיקות', implying an open list where the list is closed. A user told to file where they performed the work could file in the wrong court. When citing a list, read the CURRENT consolidated text for deletion markers rather than trusting a remembered enumeration.

The same provision turned out to carry a stronger point than the one being reached for: reg. 2(a) applies 'על אף האמור בכל הסכם שבין בעלי הדין', so a contractual venue clause does NOT bind in Small Claims, unlike general civil procedure which honours one. Reg. 2(b) also narrows online-publication and online-trade claims to the defendant's or plaintiff's residence or business only, which matters for a freelancer. Both added.

The insolvency window deferred for two cycles as unverifiable IS pinnable and is now stated: sec. 210(a) gives six months from PUBLICATION of the opening order (not from when the creditor heard), 210(b) gives 45 days for a post-order debt or the end of that period whichever is later, and 210(c) allows trustee extension for good cause. The lesson is that 'could not verify' is a status to re-test each cycle, not a permanent property of a fact.

Expert MAJOR fixed: Step 5.5 said an individual debtor 'changes which forum applies'. It does not (Small Claims takes claims against individuals and companies alike; it is the CLAIMANT who must be an individual), and it contradicted the venue text two paragraphs later. Replaced with what actually changes for an individual: no Companies Registrar record so identification comes off the contract, invoice or cheque; protected-minimum limits on garnishing wages and accounts; and a different insolvency track. That closes the individual-debtor gap as well.

Expert #1 pick taken: DISPUTED DEBT. The cycle promoted the cheque/promissory-note route twice as the shortcut that skips court, and a disputed debt collapses it, since the debtor's objection moves the file to court anyway and the opening fee is spent. That made the skill's own newly-strengthened advice point at a futile expenditure. Now covered, with getting the objection in writing early and the costs risk of pressing enforcement against a real defence. Expert #2 also taken: the personal guarantee from a controlling shareholder, plus the authorised-signatory check on a company cheque or note.
